skill_name: Compose a story about two siblings going on a camping trip with their parents.
workflow: Jimmy and his older sister Jenny were excited to go on a weekend camping trip with their parents. It was the first time for both of them and they couldn’t wait. When they arrived at the camping site, their parents quickly set up the tent, unpacked the food and supplies and started a fire to roast s’mores over.
